metadata.description: Fraud-detection OLTP over Bolt/TCP+TLS via the official Neo4j driver: load a seeded fraud graph, detect EXACTLY the planted fraud, and sustain extreme-concurrency SSI.

notes: storage.bytes_fsynced is a proxy: the WAL on-disk byte count (every committed WAL byte is fsynced before commit acknowledgement), not a directly-observed fsync counter.
Throughput window is the detection workload's ops over server uptime (a coarse proxy); latency percentiles + abort rate are measured by the drivers (GRAPHUS_STATS).
Live measurement of graphus-server over 4.000s uptime; CPU is the server's cumulative since-boot usage (the process is dedicated to this workload), RSS is sampled from the live process.

COMMITTED BASELINE (rmp #256; re-baselined under #673 for the production-realistic index/constraint schema, #682 for the RELATIONSHIP KEY on TRANSFER.tx_id). The gate compares only STABLE STRUCTURAL metrics (storage bytes/pages, operation count) at 15% and keeps a tight one-sided abort-rate livelock-drift guard (+10% rise); CPU/RAM/latency/throughput are machine-variant and NOT gated (see baseline_cmp). Recorded on linux/x86_64.

rmp #689 abort_rate re-baseline: the extreme-concurrency phase now contends the REAL mule :Account supernodes (was synthetic :Hot nodes), so the abort rate rises into the ~0.9+ regime (measured ~0.944 attaching to pi516; a target that also enforces the scan-based RELATIONSHIP KEY aborts even more). The PRIMARY abort gate is now the two-sided absolute band asserted first-class in data/concurrency.js (FRAUD_ABORT_FLOOR..CEIL, default 0.40..0.995); this baseline value (0.90) only anchors baseline_cmp's +10% livelock-drift guard (fires past ~0.99). The storage footprint is unchanged within the 15% band (the load dominates and is deterministic for a fixed seed+profile; the device/ip collusion values and the handful of concurrency deposit edges move it negligibly).
